reason.macFull: The device MAC is in the interception list
reason.hostFull: The device address is in the interception list
reason.subnetFull: The device is in the {{subnet}} subnet from the interception list. Turning it off excludes it from the subnet.
reason.excludedFull: The device is in the {{subnet}} subnet from the interception list but excluded from it, so it goes direct.
reason.excludedSubnetFull: The {{subnet}} subnet is in the exclusion list, so the device goes direct. The toggle cannot lift it: the exclusion covers other devices of the subnet too. To change it, remove {{subnet}} from source_ip_exclude in the UCI section metabox.dataplane on the router.

dialog.description: The core restarts and all devices lose their connections. Confirm that the connection works before the countdown ends. Otherwise, the previous settings will be restored.

bar.label: Interception change
bar.applying: Changing interception and restarting the core…
bar.prompt: Interception changed. Confirm the connection works,
bar.rollback: otherwise the daemon restores the previous one

failure.rolledBack: No confirmation came: the previous setting is back
failure.failed: The interception change did not go through

reason.backup_failed: the snapshot of the previous interception settings was not saved, so the daemon did not change them without a way back
reason.write_failed: the interception settings were not written to UCI
reason.restart_failed: the service did not restart with the new interception settings
reason.healthcheck_failed: the service started, but the core did not respond
reason.dns_probe_failed: the core did not answer a DNS query on the interception port
reason.interception_missing: after the restart the nft interception rules are not in place
reason.rollback_failed: rollback failed. The previous interception settings were not restored, or the core did not start with them. See the reason below
reason.no_backup: there was nothing to roll back to: the device had no previous interception settings
reason.lists_restored: only the rule-set files were restored: the device had no previous config

subnets.title: Addresses and subnets through the core
subnets.description: Traffic from devices with addresses on this list goes through the core. 192.168.1.20 matches one device and 192.168.1.0/24 matches the whole 192.168.1.x range. To exclude a device in a subnet, use its switch below.
subnets.forAll: Interception for everyone is on: the list takes effect only when interception is limited to listed devices.
subnets.hint: Enter, a comma or a space adds an entry. To change one, remove it and type it again.

error.invalid: “{{value}}” is not an IPv4 address or subnet. Write it like 192.168.1.20 or 192.168.1.0/24.
error.hostBits: {{value}} does not start the subnet: write {{subnet}}.

subnets.dialog: Apply the new list of addresses and subnets?

scope.allValue: All devices on the configured LAN interfaces
scope.question: Whose traffic should be intercepted?
scope.noDevices: The router has no devices in its inventory.
scope.empty: Select at least one device to apply this scope.
scope.reviewChanged: Settings or transaction status changed. Close this preview and review the latest scope.
scope.busy: A change is already in progress. Wait for its confirmation or rollback before applying another one.
scope.statusUnknown: The router’s transaction status is unavailable.
scope.conflict: The router settings or transaction status changed. Your selection is kept. Review the current and proposed scope again.

restriction.disabled: Interception is off. A device selection takes effect only after managed interception is set up.
restriction.unknown: Simple cannot edit this interception mode.
restriction.exclusions: This configuration has address or MAC exclusions. Simple preserves them and shows the scope read-only.
restriction.subnets: This list includes subnets. Use Devices to edit address ranges.
restriction.version: The router did not return a usable settings version. The scope is read-only.
restriction.chains: The router has not confirmed that its managed interception rules are installed. The scope is read-only.
restriction.service: Changing the scope requires a running routing service managed by metabox.

scope.leaseChanged: The address record for {{name}} at {{ip}} changed. Discard the selection and choose devices from the updated list.
